flags.message: metrics/statpack.md renders 'Segment base rate by salience band (sal-v8)', whereas record/context.json assigns band 'federal' under salience_version 'sal-v9'. Both context.json's pre-pooled cert_anchor.rate (from statpack.json's sal-v9 alt_segments) and the federal caption-class reached floor over OT2017-OT2025 equal 155/212 (0.7311), so the rendered markdown heading lag does not change the anchor.
